fhwa_recheck_adjudication.direct_finding: Section 3.8.3 lists hourly, 10 minutes, 5 minutes, and 1 minute increments for its continuous-count-station AADT calculation; the stated general formula uses equal-length time intervals. Chapter 4 also allows 5-, 10-, 15-, 20-, 30-, or 60-minute formats and says counts should use the shortest feasible interval.
fhwa_recheck_adjudication.boundary: This supports 10 minutes as a traffic-data increment in those traffic-count procedures. It does not validate the study-specific 10-minute vibration/count pairing as an adequate structural-monitoring protocol.
fhwa_recheck_adjudication.false_negative_cause: An exact find query for singular phrase "10 minute" missed the source phrasing "10 minutes"; the no-match result was incorrectly treated as evidence of absence.
